items.title: File Davis County business personal property return
items.description: Utah businesses on the county's rolls return a signed statement of personal property to the county assessor; the state default date is May 15 of the year the assessor requests it (60 days if requested on or after March 16), so use the date printed on the statement. A small-holdings exemption (about $30,100 of taxable value in 2026) must be claimed by filing; late filers pay a penalty of $25 or 10% of the tax, whichever is greater. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state rule applies. The link is the state Tax Commission publication.
